items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use a Company Tea machine at your C.A.M.P. if available

items.title: Collect Brain Fungus
items.detail: Found in dark caves like Wendigo Cave, Kerwood Mine, or Abandoned Waste Dump

items.title: Complete the Event: "The Big Bloom"
items.detail: Runs hourly at Susan's Cabin in Skyline Valley

items.title: Craft a Flower Crown
items.detail: Requires 5 Carnal Weepers and 3 Cloth at an Armor Workbench

items.title: Harvest a Firecracker Berry
items.detail: Found north and northwest of Arktos Pharma; harvest quickly before they explode

items.title: Kill an Insect during The Big Bloom Event
items.detail: Kill insects during event waves at Susan's Cabin

items.title: Kill an Overgrown during The Big Bloom Event while wearing a Flower Crown
items.detail: Equip a flower crown before killing Overgrown during event waves

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has reliable robot spawns

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from killed enemies

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Use a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. to collect board games

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Any robot type counts; RobCo Research Center is a good farming spot

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from the wild or plant crops at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt event during Slasher seasonal stage

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Buy from Mr Waiter or Ms Waitress at Whitespring, or find at Pumpkin House

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to any vendor; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. and enter their Shelter

events.name: The Big Bloom
events.description: Collect flowers, ignite overgrowth, and defeat Beezlebub in three-stage seasonal event running hourly at Susan's Cabin.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend event offering increased rewards and double mutation chances during Daily Operations.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events feature mutated variants with enhanced rewards from Mutated Party Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience points earned are doubled, accelerating leveling and Scoreboard progression.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27
events.description: Major update introducing world pets feature and launching Season 27 titled "You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L."

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event with double mutation chances and special rewards from Treasure Hunter loot.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Limited-time seasonal event featuring festive scorched enemies and exclusive holiday-themed rewards.
